step_description: Base calling of Nanopore sequencing reads using Guppy software
Quality filtering of sequencing reads using Filtlong
Assembly of filtered reads into a circular genome contig using Flye
Polishing of the assembled genome using Medaka
Automatic genome annotation using BV-BRC annotation service with PHANOTATE
Functional prediction of gene products using InterProScan
BLAST search of the genome against sequence databases
Read mapping to the assembly to assess coverage distribution
